Our culture 
 What’s the culture like at Appspace, you ask? 
 Great question. Here’s what Appspacers are saying: 
Our culture 
Here’s what Appspacers are saying: 
 Appspace isn’t just where I work, it’s where I build a career. The company culture is fantastic: I’m able to pursue what I’m passionate about and I genuinely feel like my voice is heard.
Will White, Director, Sales Engineering (US Pre-Sales) 
 The Development team focuses on creating, designing, developing, testing, and maintaining features available in the Appspace Platform. We adhere to best practices in software development, and are continually improving the same to ensure that we can deliver the best code quality using the best current technology. We communicate and collaborate between teams throughout the process and to ensure we engineer the best result.
Syed Muhammad, Director of Development 
 At Appspace, I get to thrive on opportunity. There is a fantastic level of engagement, and you always get the chance to be a part of the growth of the company.
Mubashshir Akhtar, Customer Success Manager (UK Customer Success) 
 What I like about working in Appspace is that there is never a dull moment. I have the honor of working with people that I can learn from, who will continuously push me to take up new challenges. Aside from that, the company prioritizes providing me with an enjoyable work environment and rewards the team with fun activities. As the saying goes, work hard, play hard!
Nurul Amanina, Test Manager (KL Tech) 
 Appspace is a highly innovative company focusing on delivering excellent user experience using the latest technologies. It is a great place to learn new skills and techniques.
William Law, Principal Software Architect 
 I have always imagined being a part of something bigger than myself and working alongside people that are truly supportive and genuine. At Appspace I get a chance to make a difference by being a part of the diversity and inclusion team, doing my day-to-day job driving revenue, or simply growing so that I can continuously add more value to the team. 
Brittney Hendricks, BDR (US SALES) 
 At Appspace, I found my place to face unique professional challenges while working within a highly creative, collaborative, and passionate team.
Iban Beldarrain, Director of Product Design (Spain) 
 Since Starting to work at Appspace in 2014 ive seen the company change and evolve into its current state. But a few things that have always stayed the same: The culture, the flexibility and the genuine care of each other within the business. I'm happy to say that on a Monday morning I enjoy going to work. Appspace is a family and no matter how the company has changed there has always consistently been that feeling. 
Simon Drew, Senior Customer Care Manager 
 Appspace is a place you love to work. It is challenging in the best way to work in a fast-paced environment, and this is only enhanced by the efforts made by the company and my team to put a focus on people. The culture at Appspace pushes me to develop both personally and professionally while still providing a flexible environment. I couldn’t imagine working anywhere else!
Emily Baggerman, Senior Accounting Manager (US Finance) 
 Appspace has given me the opportunity of working in a global company with a diverse and multicultural environment. I am part of something authentic and unique where I feel appreciated, recognized, and valued. I have the opportunity to improve in my career and learn from great professionals.
Sara Mora Medina, EMEA P&C Operations Specialist (P&C Barcelona)

Starting with a thorough onboarding process to regular town halls, Appspace delivers on the promise of an informative and engaging workplace. And, I can't forget to mention that the thought leadership and innovation are pretty impressive and provide some great stories that need to be shared!

I have been able to grow, not only as an engineer, but also as someone whose opinion is valued. It's a fun place to work!

 We love to learn – and keep learning
Learning and Organizational Development (L&OD) at Appspace is an ongoing process that’s a win-win for teammates and the organization as a whole. Here’s what we provide:
Learning opportunities from Day 1, starting with onboarding that dives into our company, platform, processes, and the culture that brings us together.
Leadership development that empowers you to be successful in your role. At Appspace, everyone’s a leader – whether you lead people or your own projects.
Ongoing product training that makes sure you’re up to speed on our platform, its features and capabilities, and every update along the way.
 We’re an inclusive group, and we walk the talk
Different perspectives make us stronger. That’s why diversity and inclusion are built into everything we do. We support our team members to reach their goals. And we give back to our communities through volunteering and sponsorship.
Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEIB): The Appspace DEIB Committee is made up of leads and volunteers from across the company. Our aim is to create an inclusive environment by identifying and removing systemic barriers related to (but not limited to): race, religion, gender identification, sexual orientation, and disability.
Appspace Culture Team (ACT): This team is a voluntary, grassroots committee of employees from across the organization. They meet monthly with People & Culture to discuss relevant issues, raise questions, and brainstorm ideas for making Appspace a workplace everyone loves.
 We’re a truly global team
Our teams span 17 countries, but we’re together in our commitment to creating workplaces employees love. We value hard work and flexibility, and we’re passionate about technology that helps us achieve great things.
Appspace was founded in 2002 and has offices in: 
North America: Dallas and Tampa 
EMEA: The UK, Barcelona, Madrid, and Portugal 
APAC: Malaysia 
Plus additional remote experts in a dozen other countries.

 The perks of being an Appspacer 
At Appspace, we value flexible working styles, with trust being the center of everything we do. We offer benefits that support you not just at work, but in life. 
How we hire 
 See open positions
 Your pre-screen: 
 We’ll connect you with a Talent Acquisition Specialist – your go-to contact to guide you through the hiring process from start to finish. 
1 
 Google Meet interviews: 
 You’ll meet several interviewers related to the role you applied for. An interviewer could be the hiring manager, a team leader, a future peer, or a key stakeholder. 
2 
 ‘Get to know you’ lunch: 
 For some specialty positions you may be asked to complete a skills-based assessment, mock demo, or meet in person for lunch. 
3 
 Feedback and offer discussion: 
 It’s a wrap. Your Talent Acquisition Specialist will connect to discuss interview feedback and a potential offer. If you're not the right fit, we'll let you know and keep you in mind for other opportunities. 
4 
 Giving back to our communities 
 We support a culture of giving back. We’re proud to be a strategic partner of Think Big for Kids – a non-profit with a big goal: to break the cycle of poverty by providing middle and high school students with career opportunities, mentorship, and job readiness to thrive in today’s workforce. We partner with schools in Tampa and Dallas to make sure every kid knows how big their potential is to do great things, no matter who they are, or where they come from. 
 Want to know more or get involved?

FAQS 
You’ve got questions,
we've got answers 
 What's the culture like at Appspace?  
At Appspace, we recognize our employees are the keys to our success. We’re heavily invested in our team’s wellbeing, both in and outside the workplace. We provide a comprehensive benefits package to enrich employee wellness. And we’ve created a culture that celebrates diversity and encourages open communication between all employees.
 What is Appspace’s remote work policy?  
We offer flexible working schedules for all employees. All full-time employees are eligible to work 100% remotely. If an employee is located in a state where Appspace has an office, they’ve got the option to go into the office.
 What does the office environment at Appspace look like?  
We’ve got offices around the world, and each one reflects its local culture. All of our offices are open concept to encourage team collaboration. 
 Can I apply to multiple jobs?  
Yes, of course!
 What if I need accommodation for my interview?  
If you need assistance and/or an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request to HR@Appspace.com
 What type of benefits will I receive as a Appspace employee? 
That depends on where you’re located (each country has its own specific benefits plan).
